reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V2 (the agent's declared best variant) by importing triage.linear_st_yaw_rate from the agent's skills/lateral-fidelity-triage with Mach-E openpilot-canonical params (C_alpha_f=286551, C_alpha_r=355912, L=2.984, l_f=1.313, l_r=1.671, m=2336, I_z=4879.05) and v_min=2.0 m/s KS fallback, applying per-segment straight-line bias removal as in run_triage.py.
notes: Agent only fit/declared V2 with Mach-E params; canonical eval pools across both Ford platforms (Mach-E + F-150 Lightning), so Mach-E-specific parameters are applied to the heavier Lightning segments as well — this is the model the agent shipped, not a re-fit. Per-segment straight-line bias (|delta|<0.01) was recomputed for every canonical segment per the agent's run_triage.py V2 block. Baseline recomputed from sim.csv's yaw_rate_pred_rads matches the canonical V0 to within float tolerance.
